title: Monochromatic Portrait with Text Overlay
coreRelationships: The woman's pose conveys a sense of vulnerability or contemplation.
The sepia tone unifies the image and evokes a vintage or timeless feel.
The double-line frame creates a contained, art-like presentation for the portrait.
The typography is subtly integrated, complementing the image without overpowering it.
reuseFormula: Recreate a sepia-toned, low-saturation portrait of a pensive woman, framed by subtle double lines. Overlay minimalist, all-caps serif text in a light tone, centered above the subject, using a font that evokes classic elegance.
